header: IN THE HIGH COURT OF SINDH
DATE ORDER WITH SIGNATURE OF JUDGE
Mr. Mir Muhammad Nohri, advocate for the petitioner.
Mr. Raj Kumar, advocate for the respondent No.7.
Mr. Ghulamullah Memon, A.A.G a/w D.D (Technical) S.E.P.A,
Mr. Muhammad Rafique, advocate for the Chairman Town
body: Municipal Corporation, Mir Sher Muhammad Khan Talpur, Mirpurkhas.

Through this petition, the petitioner seeks the following relief(s):a. Direct Respondents Nos. 3 to 8 to immediately undertake a comprehensive cleanliness and municipal-services operation throughout Mirpurkhas, including regular sweeping and garbage collection, removal of accumulated waste and stagnant sewage, cleaning and repair of drains, fumigation and mosquito control, restoration of street lights, and installation of an adequate number of covered and durable public dustbins at streets, markets, public gardens, parks, commercial areas, hospitals, educational areas and other appropriate public places, within definite timelines fixed by this Honourable Court;' b. Direct Respondents Nos. 1 to 8 to produce the complete budgetary, financial, administrative and utilization records of the Municipal Corporation Mirpurkhas, both Town Municipal Corporations and all Union Committees within their jurisdiction for the relevant financial. years, including grants, releases, revenue, expenditures, development schemes, procurements, contracts, audit reports, utilization certificates, bank accounts and details showing where and for what purpose each amount was utilized;

c. Direct Respondents Nos. 2 to 8 to produce verified lists and complete service records of all employees of the Municipal Corporation, Town Municipal Corporations and Union Committees, including sanctioned and filled posts, names, designations, grades, postings, salaries, pensions, biometric attendance, duty rosters and actual deployment, together with complete inventories and operational records of all municipal vehicles, machinery, equipment and other assets; d. Direct Respondents Nos. 2 to 8 to submit a comprehensive report regarding the municipal fire brigade and emergency services, including the number and location of fire stations, fire engines, water bowsers and rescue vehicles; their operational condition; available water sources; sanctioned, filled and vacant posts; trained personnel; protective and firefighting equipment; emergency telephone facilities; average response time; fuel, repair and maintenance expenditure; and an effective time-bound plan for making the fire and rescue services fully functional;

e. Direct Respondents Nos. 1, 2, 9 and 10 to conduct or cause a joint inspection and statutory audit of the municipal services, funds, employees, vehicles, machinery, dustbin requirements, drainage system, street lights and fire-brigade facilities; fix responsibility in accordance with law for any negligence, unauthorized expenditure, absenteeism, non-performance or financial irregularity established through such inquiry; and submit periodic compliance reports supported by affidavits, official records and dated photographs; and f. Direct the Respondents to prepare, publish and implement sustainable Union Committee-wise municipal-services plan identifying territorial boundaries, responsible officers, sanitation workers, vehicles, garbage-collection routes, locations and emptying schedules of dustbins, drainage-maintenance schedules, street-light restoration, fire-service coverage and a functional public complaint mechanism; keep the petition pending as a continuing mandamus until substantial compliance is achieved; and grant any other consequential or appropriate relief, including costs, deemed just and proper in the circumstances.

f. Further pray before this Honourable court to depute any neutral commissioner/judicial officer for conduct surprise visit and inquiry of Municipal corporation jurisdictions and submit report before this honorable court for consideration of facts.

After notices, respondent No.5 files comments today. Mr. Muhammad Rafique advocate files Vakalatnama on behalf of Chairman Town Municipal Corporation, Mir Sher Muhammad Khan Talpur, Mirpurkhas which is taken on record. The Chairman Town Municipal Corporation, Mir Sher Muhammad Khan Talpur, Mirpurkhas present and undertakes to act fully in accordance with law and redress the grievance of the petitioner within 30 days.

In view of such undertaking, this petition is disposed of with directions to the respondents to act strictly in accordance with the law and redress the grievance of petitioner. They are further directed to continue the cleanliness of the entire city within their respective jurisdictions. JUDGE JUDGE Salik
